scoring.attendanceRule: Every player in a finalized Regular game earns 10 attendance points; a final-table finish adds its bonus on top. Championship and Big Stack nights do not count toward the season.
scoring.tieRule: Players tied at a finish split the bonuses of the places they cover (for example a two-way tie for 2nd shares 2nd and 3rd), averaged and rounded UP to the nearest 5.
scoring.standingsOrder: points desc, then games played desc, then RSVPs honored desc, then name A-Z
scoring.standingsTieRule: Players tie when points, games played and RSVPs honored are all equal; tied players share the higher rank and the next rank is skipped.
scoring.winDefinition: A win is a 1st-place finish; any win this season gives a championship berth.

championship.openSeatRule: A seat opens when its holder declines, or when doors close and they have not checked in. Open seats go to checked-in alternates (rank 21 and below) in rank order.
championship.consolationRule: Consolation seats go to checked-in players without a main seat, in arrival order; past the cap they wait in arrival order.
